title: Stasis Collision
description: A woman in a torn yellow hazmat suit with '609' on the chest runs forward with a fearful expression, pulled by a man in a tattered black trench coat and mechanical arm. They are in a derelict vault hallway marked 'FALLOUT ARCHIVE 2278' with radiation symbols, scattered paintings, broken frames, and glowing purple lights.
prompt: A dramatic post-apocalyptic scene inside a decaying vault hallway labeled FALLOUT ARCHIVE 2278. A terrified woman in a torn yellow hazmat suit with 609 printed on the chest is being pulled by a rugged man in a long black tattered coat with a mechanical arm. They are surrounded by radiation warning symbols, scattered broken paintings and frames on the floor, glowing purple overhead lights, green slime, and debris. Dynamic action composition with strong cinematic lighting.
